title: Layer 3 round 3 major QE+SE: the degenerate-budget falsifier goes vacuous (unwrap_or empty masks a budget-ignoring mutant), and the three main.rs diagnostic prints have no falsifier at all

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 94d3c2cf: the degenerate-budget falsifier no longer goes vacuous — it locates the work-item field structurally by its registered order (the third of four) with an expect, and asserts a hard-cut prefix of the real value rather than accepting emptiness, so a budget-ignoring mutant that renders the full field is caught. The three cmd_status diagnostic eprintlns gained the_status_command_cleans_config_diagnostics_on_stderr: it runs the built binary (CARGO_BIN_EXE_vsdd) in the real repo root against a repo-set config carrying an escape byte near a syntax error and asserts stderr carries no 0x1b — a reversion of any of the three prints to raw now turns a test red.
